segments.sn54.6:1.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā ariṭṭho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn54.6:1.6: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, ariṭṭha, bhāvesi ānāpānassatin”ti?
segments.sn54.6:1.7: “Atītesu me, bhante, kāmesu kāmacchando pahīno, anāgatesu me kāmesu kāmacchando vigato, ajjhattabahiddhā [ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] ca me dhammesu paṭighasaññā suppaṭivinītā.
segments.sn54.6:2.2: Api ca, ariṭṭha, yathā ānāpānassati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hoti taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi;
segments.sn54.6:2.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ariṭṭho bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.sn54.6:3.2: Idha, ariṭṭha, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
segments.sn54.6:3.4: Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti … pe …‘paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati,‘paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
segments.sn54.6:3.6: Evaṃ kho, ariṭṭha, ānāpānassati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hotī”ti.

lines: Ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca dhammesūti ajjhattikabāhiresu dvādasasu āyatanadhammesu.
Paṭighasaññā suppaṭivinītāti paṭighasampayuttasaññā suṭṭhu paṭivinītā, samucchinnāti attho.
Idāni arahattamaggassa vipassanaṃ dassento so satova assasissāmītiādimāha.
No -saddo pucchāyaṃ, tasmā nūti iminā samānatthoti āha “bhāvetha nū”ti.
Iminā kāmacchandappahānakittanena paṭighasaññāpaṭivinayakittanena ca anāgāmimaggaṃ katheti pañcorambhāgiyasaññojanasamucchedassa byākatattā.
